create_reach_task: create a Reach task instance with an arena, arm, hand, prop, and workspace configuration
build_reach_duplo_features: build a reach task using a Duplo prop target with perfect feature observations
build_reach_site_features: build a reach task using a fixed site target with perfect feature observations
compute_reach_reward: compute the tolerance-based reward from hand TCP position to target position distance
initialize_reach_episode: initialize a reach episode by randomizing hand grasp, TCP position, and target placement
